messages:
DeployBot: Starting rollout v2.17 to smoke pool now. route=smoke, percent=10% :rocket:
Eli: seeing a spike in alert flood already — multiple `/alerts` from the smoke pool. weird that latency SLO graphs are flatlined though
Maya: jump in. confirm whether smoke traffic is routed to canary backend or prod variant? I thought smoke uses replica set B
Sam: DeployBot shows target set B. logs show env=smoke tag but our dashboard query for smoke uses tag=smoke-v2, so likely mismatch. throwing a few noisy alerts on p50/p95
Carla: I'm getting a pager from PagerBot for high error-rate on /generate. linking logs: `ERROR 502 backend grpc failed: upstream timeout` x16
Eli: can we mute the noisy alert rule temporarily? it's drowning out other signals. also I can't find the smoke dashboard — the usual smoke dashboard  -> links 404
Maya: confirmed dashboard 404. dashboard id changed during the last infra cleanup, queries reference `deployment_tag` field that new rollout didn't populate. dashboard query returns empty -> alerting rules treat that as 0 and flip to firing because of missing baseline.
Sam: that is the smoking gun — missing metrics caused alert rules to interpret zero-values as anomalies. we should suppress those alerts. I'm going to set rule: `suppress if dashboard_query_missing==true` (manual)
DeployBot: Rollout paused at 10% per health check failure threshold
Eli: good pause. can we flip the feature flag for v2.17 to abort? flag name `smoke_rollout_v2_17`
Carla: issuing kill via FF console now. `ff:smoke_rollout_v2_17 -> OFF` :white_check_mark:
PagerBot: Incident created: #INC-237654-A — title: smoke rollout alert flood. primary_oncall=Eli. severity=high.
Eli: attaching quick mitigation steps: 1) FF kill done 2) Pause the smoke job 3) Mute noisy alert rule `alerts/smoke:high-error-rate` 4) Re-enable legacy tag population job (temp)
Maya: on the metric side, the agent that populates `deployment_tag` failed due to a schema change in v2.17. There's a failing migration: `migrate_tags.sh` exited non-zero. logs: ```
2026-03-15T09:41:12Z migrate_tags.sh: error: unknown field "tag_version"
```
Sam: re-run migration with fallback flag `--legacy-mode` to restore tags. I'll run now.
Sam: ran `./migrate_tags.sh --legacy-mode --target smoke` — got 97% success, some hosts still pending. pushing a retry for pending hosts.
Carla: alert rule muted. also created a temporary dashboard mapping smoke->legacy_tag so graphs show values again.
Eli: customer impact check — internal telemetry shows ~120 requests failed with 502 in the smoke pool; no external customer impact detected (smoke targets internal QA only). marking P0? I'd say P2 since no external customers affected but platform signal noisy
Nora: posting timeline in incidents channel after we stabilize. please add any SLA notes.
DeployBot: Rollout rollback started automatically per policy (since FF kill and pause).
Maya: migration retry finished, `deployment_tag` populated for all smoke hosts. dashboards rehydrate.
Sam: unmuting alerts now but keeping severity lower for 10m to observe.
Eli: thanks. post-incident actions: - add a guard in rollout to verify tag population before increasing percent - update dashboard queries to not interpret missing as 0 (use `absent()` checks) - add an integration test for `migrate_tags.sh` in release pipeline - add runbook step for muting noisy rules quickly
Carla: filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-4312 "dashboard queries treat missing metrics as zero -> leads to false firing" and assigning to Maya + Sam.
Nora: prepping a short incident note for execs: no customer impact, root cause = tag migration bug in v2.17, mitigations = FF kill & migration fallback, follow-ups assigned.
Eli: closing thread when ticket created and monitoring looks stable for 20m :eyes:
Sam: monitoring green for 12m, no new 502s. leaving extended watch for 30m.
DeployBot: Rollout fully rolled back for v2.17 (all smoke targets reverted).
Eli: thanks everyone. quick retro scheduled in 1h. add logs/snippets to the incident doc. :coffee:
